data.title: 爱蜜莉雅 · 睡前童话
data.description: 【爱蜜莉雅 · 睡前童话】深夜昏黄的床头灯下，爱蜜莉雅只着薄透睡衣趴在松软的大枕头上翻看童话书，雪白的双足在半空中轻轻晃动。她转过脸拉了拉被角——「昴，这本书里的故事有些地方我看不懂……可以躺到我身边，亲自念给我听吗？」
data.action: 深夜趴在松软大枕头上看童话书，双足轻晃
data.lighting: warm bedside-lamp light across the book, pillow and near blanket folds
data.promptProse: She lies on a soft pillow with her feet raised, one hand holding the storybook open while the other tugs the blanket edge toward the viewer. The warm bedside lamp lights the page and her nightgown.
data.animaCaption: One hand holds the book while the other tugs the blanket toward the viewer.
